text: The streetlight on my block has not been working for two weeks and it is very dark at night.
There has been no heat or hot water in my apartment for three days now.
Someone has been parked in front of my driveway blocking my car all morning.
Loud music and a party next door keeping the whole building awake past 2am.
Water is leaking from the ceiling in my bathroom and the pipe seems burst.
There is a huge pile of garbage and trash bags dumped on the corner that nobody collected.
A car has been abandoned on my street for over a month with flat tires and no plates.
I keep seeing rats running around the back of the building near the bins.
The road is full of huge potholes and the pavement is cracked and uneven.
The elevator in our building has been broken and stuck for days.
Raw sewage is backing up into the basement and it smells terrible.
A large tree branch fell down and is hanging dangerously over the sidewalk.
There is a homeless encampment with tents that has taken over the park entrance.
The paint is peeling off the walls and there are cracks in the plaster in the hallway.
A dead animal is lying on the side of the road and has been there for days.
Illegal fireworks are being set off every night in the neighborhood.
The traffic light at the intersection is completely out and it is dangerous.
There is a strong smell of gas and possible asbestos dust from the construction site.
My landlord refuses to fix the broken window that won't close in winter.
The street light keeps flickering on and off all night.
Cars keep double parking and blocking the whole lane during rush hour.
Constant construction noise starting at 6 in the morning from the site nearby.
There is standing water and a clogged drain flooding the street after rain.
Someone dumped an old mattress and furniture on the sidewalk illegally.
The apartment has no electricity in half the rooms and the outlets spark.
A pack of stray dogs is roaming the block and they seem aggressive.
The sidewalk is completely broken and a tree root has pushed the pavement up.
People are selling counterfeit goods from an unlicensed street stall.
There is a foul smell and unsanitary conditions in the shared hallway.
The heat is not turning on at all and it is freezing inside.
A man is aggressively panhandling and harassing people at the subway entrance.
My toilet keeps overflowing and water is spreading across the floor.
The noise from the bar downstairs is unbearable every weekend night.
There are cockroaches and mice all over the kitchen of the restaurant.
A vehicle has been stripped for parts and left rusting on the corner.
The curb and road surface collapsed leaving a dangerous hole.
